question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"beloved"** means someone who is dearly loved or cherished. (प्रिय)

 
 
• **Example:** She was his beloved wife, and he cherished every moment with her.
 
 
 
• **"Beloved"** refers to someone who is loved very much, often used to describe someone who holds a special place in one's heart. (प्रिय)
 
 
• **Example:** The author's beloved pet dog was often featured in his stories.
 
 

Therefore, the correct word for fill in the blank no. 1 is **beloved**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Overlooked** (नज़रअंदाज़ किया हुआ): Fail to notice or consider something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The small details in the painting were often** overlooked** by casual observers.
 
 
 
• **Scorned** (तिरस्कृत): Treated with disdain or contempt.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt **scorned **by her colleagues after the incident.
 
 
 
• **Despised** (घृणित): To feel a strong dislike for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** He** despised **dishonesty in any form.
